qAndA.answer: Socks are crucial for the Camino because they prevent blisters, which can be a common issue due to the long distances covered on foot.

qAndA.answer: Merino wool is excellent for hiking socks as it absorbs sweat effectively, keeping the feet dry and comfortable.

qAndA.answer: For summer hikes, the hiker suggests thinner Merino wool socks specifically designed for running.

text_to_speech: and now the time for the second part of equipment that surely you will need and the second most important part of your equipment are the socks this can prevent any blisters that you might have on the Camino the hiking sock stick perfectly to your feet that prevent excessive Rush there are a few different fabrics and materials but we strongly recommend Marino wool which absorbs all the unnecessary accessory flavors and smells that you can imagine also regulates the temperature of your feet and one important thing if you do your Camino in summer there are special hiking Marino wool socks made for running much thinner and these could be really good options for you by the way

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: And now the time for the second part of equipment that surely you will need.
And the second most important part of your equipment are the socks.
This can prevent any blisters that you might have on the Camino.
The hiking socks stick perfectly to your feet that prevent excessive rush.
There are a few different fabrics and materials but we strongly recommend Merino Wool,
which absorbs all the unnecessary flavours and smells that you can imagine.
Also regulates the temperature of your feet.
And one important thing if you do your Camino in summer, there are special hiking
Merino Wool socks made for running. Much thinner and this could be really good options for you.
